notes: לְבָד is split rather than fused because the ASV spends a word on each morpheme (rules 2, 30).
The waw before the second כֹל takes the *likewise* the ASV wrote for it (rule 14).
The article on כֶּלֶב is unrepresented, the ASV rendering the noun indefinitely and the *a* belonging to the noun (rules 15, 29).
